scope: 32 .cs files directly under src/RackCad.Plugin/ (the top-level command classes RackAyuda/Cabecera/Cama/Cantilever/Dinamico/Duplicar/Inventario(+BomTotal)/Layout(+Fill)/Menu/Propiedades/PushBack/Seccion/Selectivo/Variables, plus helpers and executors: CustomPropertiesData, CustomPropertiesExecutor, InDocumentTransaction, LayerHelper, PluginInitializer, ProjectVariableMutationExecutor, ProjectVariablesData, ProjectVariablesRegistry, RackBlockFinder, RackCatalogLoader, RackCloner, RackCommandSupport, RackEnvelopeRestamp, RackUnitsGuard, StructuralSectionCatalogAccess, StructuralSectionCommandFlow). Excluded by rule: src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/** (including Drawing/Cantilever/**), Systems/** and KindHandlers/**. Tree: the extract of commit 3375aadb. RESULT (FACT): these 32 files declare NO mutable static state. There are no non-readonly static fields, no static readonly field that references a mutable object, no static auto-property with a setter, no [ThreadStatic], ThreadLocal or AsyncLocal, no static events, no singleton instances, no static constructors and no module initializers. The only static field in scope is an immutable delegate (entry 1). Two instance auto-properties on a command class are listed as OTHER because a command-class instance may outlive one invocation (entries 2 and 3). None of the three is reachable from the seam paths, and none carries warm-up risk. Every cache and logger that the seam paths reach from these files lives outside the scope (see limitations).
